SmartWings’ Black Friday and Cyber Monday sale starts November 15, 2026, with 10% off sitewide or 15% off orders over $1,500. The featured custom motorized shades on sale are available in a variety of styles, including roller, cellular, and linen Roman, to suit different rooms and design preferences.

For Apple Home users, choosing a compatible motor adds another way to automate the house: open your shades in the morning, close them in the evening, or adjust them with a voice command. Check out the styles included in the sale and discover what to consider when choosing the right shades for your windows.
